provenance.swift:
Apple Swift version 6.4 (swiftlang-6.4.0.34.1 clang-2100.3.34.1)
Target: arm64-apple-macosx27.2.0
provenance.instrumentation: none; identical Release benchmark with test-only fixture extraction/source selection

method: Two complete four-round crossover passes of separate process runs. Summary is median of all eight run medians and full run-median range; ratios divide those summary medians. No runs or samples removed.
repeatReason: First pass had sustained high baseline timings in some 1080p cases and round 3 4K MMR in-place; repeat used identical binaries and protocol. Clock state and cause were not measured.

passes.comparisonMethod: matched crossover rounds of separate process runs; changes compare per-run medians, not paired command buffers

report.gpuTimingMethod: difference of cumulative meanGPUTimeMs * successful call count, before frame 120
report.scope: single in-flight production async composition; completion latency includes encode and callback delivery; excludes reset, decode, rendering and IO

passes.calibration: Pool/in-place output hashes compare only final sequence 69 (frame 1) within each engine, not every output frame and not different engines with intentionally different arithmetic.
passes.limitation: Mac single-frame composition comparison, not Apple TV playback or deadline validation. The RPU is parsed once per profile/dimensions and parameters are reused; RPU parsing and mapping-slot state handling are excluded. Per-compose LUT generation/upload, encoding and callback delivery are included in completion latency. Decode, rendering, contention and source restoration are excluded; the CPU delta covers composition, not the whole playback pipeline.
